name: IsDiagonalisable.ofBialgEquiv
statement:
lemma IsDiagonalisable.ofBialgEquiv {B : Type*} [Semiring B] [Bialgebra R B]
    [hA : IsDiagonalisable R A] (e : A ≃ₐc[R] B) : IsDiagonalisable R B
proof:
:= by
  nontriviality R
  obtain ⟨G, _, ⟨e'⟩⟩ := hA
  replace e := e'.symm.trans e
  have eG := Equiv.ofInjective _ (e.injective.comp of_injective)
  let := eG.symm.group
  exact ⟨_, _, ⟨((domCongrBialgEquiv R R eG.symm.mulEquiv).trans e).symm⟩⟩

name: span_isGroupLikeElem_eq_top_of_isDiagonalisable
statement:
lemma span_isGroupLikeElem_eq_top_of_isDiagonalisable :
    IsDiagonalisable R A → Submodule.span R {a : A | IsGroupLikeElem R a} = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨⟨G, _, ⟨e⟩⟩⟩
  rw [← Submodule.comap_top (e : A ≃ₗ[R] R[G]).toLinearMap,
    ← span_isGroupLikeElem (R := R), Submodule.comap_equiv_eq_map_symm, Submodule.map_span]
  simp [AlgEquiv.image_symm_eq_preimage]

name: liftGroupLikeBialgHom_bijective_of_span_isGroupLikeElem_eq_top
statement:
lemma liftGroupLikeBialgHom_bijective_of_span_isGroupLikeElem_eq_top
    (h : Submodule.span R {a : A | IsGroupLikeElem R a} = ⊤) :
    Bijective (liftGroupLikeBialgHom (R := R) (A := A))
proof:
:= by
  have : Nontrivial A := Bialgebra.nontrivial R
  refine ⟨?_, fun b ↦ ?_⟩
  · rw [RingHom.injective_iff_ker_eq_bot, RingHom.ker_eq_bot_iff_eq_zero]
    refine fun x hx ↦ MonoidAlgebra.coeff_eq_zero.1 <|
      linearIndependent_iff.1 linearIndep_groupLikeVal _ ?_
    simpa [Algebra.smul_def, Finsupp.linearCombination_apply, MonoidAlgebra.lift_apply, liftNC,
      Finsupp.liftAddHom, Function.comp_def] using hx
  · obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := (Finsupp.mem_span_setOf_iff_exists_linearCombination (x := b)).mp
      (by rw [h]; exact Submodule.mem_top)
    use .ofCoeff (x.equivMapDomain GroupLike.valEquiv.symm)
    simpa [liftNC, Finsupp.liftAddHom, Algebra.smul_def, Finsupp.linearCombination_apply,
      MonoidAlgebra.lift_apply] using hx

name: not_isSplitTorusOver_SO
statement: theorem not_isSplitTorusOver_SO₂_real : ¬ SO₂(ℝ).IsSplitTorusOver (Spec ↧ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  intro
  obtain ⟨σ, _, e, _, _⟩ := exists_iso_diag_finite_of_isSplitTorusOver_locallyOfFiniteType SO₂(ℝ) <|
    Spec ↧ℝ
  have : (e ≪≫ diagSpecIso _ ℤ[σ]).hom.IsOver (Spec ↧ℝ) := by dsimp; infer_instance
  have : IsMonHom ((e ≪≫ diagSpecIso _ ℤ[σ]).asOver <| Spec ↧ℝ).hom := by
    dsimp; infer_instance
  have e₁ := Hom.mulEquivCongrRight ((e ≪≫ diagSpecIso _ ℤ[σ]).asOver <| Spec ↧ℝ)
    ((Spec ↧ℝ).asOver <| Spec ↧ℝ)
  have e₂ : (ℤ[σ] →+ Additive ℝˣ) ≃+ (σ → Additive ℝˣ) :=
    AddMonoidAlgebra.coeffAddEquiv.addMonoidHomCongrLeft.trans <| Finsupp.liftAddHom.symm.trans <|
      .piCongrRight («η» := σ) fun _ ↦ (zmultiplesAddHom <| Additive ℝˣ).symm
  exact (aux3 σ).1 <| (pointsMulEquiv ℝ).symm.trans <| e₁.trans <| Spec.mapMulEquiv.symm.trans <|
    (AddMonoidAlgebra.liftMulEquiv ℝ ℝ ℤ[σ]).symm.trans <| MonoidHom.toHomUnitsMulEquiv.trans <|
      MonoidHom.toAdditiveRightMulEquiv.trans <| e₂.toMultiplicative.trans <| .refl _

name: exists_iso_diag_finite_of_isSplitTorusOver_locallyOfFiniteType
statement:
lemma exists_iso_diag_finite_of_isSplitTorusOver_locallyOfFiniteType [G.IsSplitTorusOver S]
    [hG : LocallyOfFiniteType (G ↘ S)] [Nonempty S] :
    ∃ (ι : Type u) (_ : Finite ι) (e : G ≅ Diag S ℤ[ι]) (_ : e.hom.IsOver S),
      IsMonHom (e.hom.asOver S)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨A, _, _, e, _, _⟩ := ‹G.IsSplitTorusOver S›
  replace hG : LocallyOfFiniteType (Diag S A ↘ S) := by
    rw [← MorphismProperty.cancel_left_of_respectsIso @LocallyOfFiniteType e.hom]
    erw [comp_over e.hom]
    assumption
  rw [locallyOfFiniteType_diag_iff] at hG
  exact ⟨Module.Free.ChooseBasisIndex ℤ A, inferInstance,
    e.trans <| Diag.mapIso S <| (Module.Free.chooseBasis ℤ A).repr.toAddEquiv.trans
      AddMonoidAlgebra.coeffAddEquiv.symm,
    by dsimp; infer_instance, by dsimp; infer_instance⟩

name: IsTorusOver.of_iso
statement:
lemma IsTorusOver.of_iso (e : G ≅ H) [e.hom.IsOver <| Spec ↧k]
    [IsMonHom <| e.hom.asOver <| Spec ↧k] [H.IsTorusOver k] : G.IsTorusOver k
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨L, _, _, _, hH⟩ := ‹H.IsTorusOver k›
  refine ⟨L, _, ‹_›, ‹_›, ?_⟩
  let e'' := (Over.pullback <| Spec.map <| CommRingCat.ofHom <| algebraMap k L).mapGrp.mapIso <|
    Grp.mkIso' <| e.asOver <| Spec ↧k
  let e' := (Grp.forget _ ⋙ Over.forget _).mapIso e''
  dsimp at e'
  have : e'.hom.IsOver (Spec ↧L) := by simp [e', e'']
  have : IsMonHom <| e'.hom.asOver <| Spec ↧L := by
    simpa using! Mon.instIsMonHomHom e''.hom.hom
  exact .of_iso e'

name: locallyOfFiniteType_diag_iff
statement:
@[simp] lemma locallyOfFiniteType_diag_iff [hS : Nonempty S] :
    LocallyOfFiniteType (Diag S M ↘ S) ↔ AddMonoid.FG M where
  mpr _
proof:
:= inferInstance
  mp h := by
    wlog hS : ∃ R, S = Spec R
    · obtain ⟨x⟩ := ‹Nonempty S›
      obtain ⟨i, x, rfl⟩ := S.affineCover.exists_eq x
      have that : Nonempty (S.affineCover.X i) := ⟨x⟩
      refine this (S := S.affineCover.X i) ?_ ⟨_, rfl⟩
      have : LocallyOfFiniteType (pullback.fst (S.affineCover.f i) (S.Diag M ↘ S)) :=
        MorphismProperty.pullback_fst _ _ ‹_›
      rw [← diagPullbackIso_inv_fst (S.affineCover.f i)]
      infer_instance
    obtain ⟨R, rfl⟩ := hS
    rw [Spec_carrier, PrimeSpectrum.nonempty_iff_nontrivial] at hS
    replace h : LocallyOfFiniteType (Spec ↧R[M] ↘ Spec R) := by
      rw [← MorphismProperty.cancel_left_of_respectsIso @LocallyOfFiniteType
        (diagSpecIso R M).hom]
      erw [comp_over]
      assumption
    simpa [specOverSpec_over, HasRingHomProperty.Spec_iff (P := @LocallyOfFiniteType),
      RingHom.finiteType_algebraMap, AddMonoidAlgebra.finiteType_iff_fg] using h

name: commHopfAlgCatEquivCogrpCommAlgCat_functor_map_ofHom_mul
statement:
@[simp]
lemma commHopfAlgCatEquivCogrpCommAlgCat_functor_map_ofHom_mul
    {R S T : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [CommRing T]
    [HopfAlgebra R S] [HopfAlgebra R T] [Coalgebra.IsCocomm R S] (f g : WithConv <| S →ₐc[R] T) :
    (commHopfAlgCatEquivCogrpCommAlgCat _).functor.map (CommHopfAlgCat.ofHom (f * g).ofConv) =
      (((commHopfAlgCatEquivCogrpCommAlgCat _).functor.map (CommHopfAlgCat.ofHom f.ofConv)).unop *
      ((commHopfAlgCatEquivCogrpCommAlgCat _).functor.map (CommHopfAlgCat.ofHom g.ofConv)).unop).op
proof:
:= by
  apply Quiver.Hom.unop_inj
  ext1
  apply Quiver.Hom.unop_inj
  ext1
  convert_to! (f * g).ofConv =
    (Algebra.TensorProduct.lift (AlgHomClass.toAlgHom f.ofConv) (AlgHomClass.toAlgHom g.ofConv)
      (fun _ _ ↦ .all _ _)).comp (Bialgebra.comulAlgHom _ _)
  dsimp [BialgHom.convMul_def]
  rw [← AlgHom.comp_assoc]
  congr 1
  ext <;> simp

statement:
@[ext]
lemma HomGrp.toHom_injective : Function.Injective (HomGrp.hom (G := G) (G' := G') (S := S))
proof:
:= by
  intros _ _ H; delta HomGrp; ext; exact H

name: HomGrp.hom_comp
statement:
@[simp]
lemma HomGrp.hom_comp (f : HomGrp G G' S) (g : HomGrp G' G'' S) :
    (f.comp g).hom = f.hom ≫ g.hom

name: HomGrp.comp_add
statement:
lemma HomGrp.comp_add [IsCommMonObj (G'.asOver S)] [IsCommMonObj (G''.asOver S)]
    (f f' : HomGrp G G' S) (g : HomGrp G' G'' S) :
    (f + f').comp g = f.comp g + f'.comp g
proof:
:= by
  apply Additive.toMul.injective
  dsimp [HomGrp.comp, HomGrp]
  exact MonObj.mul_comp f.toMul f'.toMul g.toMul

name: HomGrp.comp_zero
statement:
@[simp]
lemma HomGrp.comp_zero [IsCommMonObj (G''.asOver S)] (f : HomGrp G G' S) :
    f.comp (0 : HomGrp G' G'' S) = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply Additive.toMul.injective
  dsimp [HomGrp.comp, HomGrp]
  exact MonObj.comp_one _

name: HomGrp.zero_comp
statement:
@[simp]
lemma HomGrp.zero_comp [IsCommMonObj (G'.asOver S)] [IsCommMonObj (G''.asOver S)]
    (f : HomGrp G' G'' S) : (0 : HomGrp G G' S).comp f = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply Additive.toMul.injective
  dsimp [HomGrp.comp, HomGrp]
  exact MonObj.one_comp f.toMul

name: HomGrp.add_comp
statement:
lemma HomGrp.add_comp [IsCommMonObj (G''.asOver S)] (f : HomGrp G G' S) (g g' : HomGrp G' G'' S) :
    f.comp (g + g') = f.comp g + f.comp g'
proof:
:= by
  apply Additive.toMul.injective
  dsimp [HomGrp.comp, HomGrp]
  exact MonObj.comp_mul _ _ _

name: diagHomGrp_comp
statement:
lemma diagHomGrp_comp {M N O : Type u} [AddCommGroup M] [AddCommGroup N] [AddCommGroup O]
    (f : M →+ N) (g : N →+ O) :
    (diagHomGrp S g).comp (diagHomGrp S f) = diagHomGrp S (g.comp f)
proof:
:= by
  simpa [HomGrp, diagHomGrp, HomGrp.comp]
    using (S.diagFunctor.map_comp (AddCommGrpCat.ofHom g).op (AddCommGrpCat.ofHom f).op).symm

name: diagHomGrp_add
statement:
lemma diagHomGrp_add {M N : Type u} [AddCommGroup M] [AddCommGroup N] (f g : M →+ N) :
    diagHomGrp S (f + g) = diagHomGrp S f + diagHomGrp S g
proof:
:= by
  simpa [diagHomGrp] using congr(Additive.ofMul $(diagFunctor_map_add (S := S) f g))

name: diagHomEquiv_apply
IsDiagonalisable.of_iso
statement:
lemma IsDiagonalisable.of_iso [IsDiagonalisable S H]
    (e : G ≅ H) [e.hom.IsOver S] [IsMonHom <| e.hom.asOver S] : IsDiagonalisable S G
proof:
:=
  let ⟨A, _, e', _, _⟩ := ‹IsDiagonalisable S H›
  ⟨A, _, e.trans e', by dsimp; infer_instance, by dsimp; infer_instance⟩

name: IsDiagonalisable.of_isIso
statement:
lemma IsDiagonalisable.of_isIso [IsDiagonalisable S H]
    (f : G ⟶ H) [IsIso f] [f.IsOver S] [IsMonHom (f.asOver S)] : IsDiagonalisable S G

name: specCommMonAlgPullbackObjXIso_one
statement:
lemma specCommMonAlgPullbackObjXIso_one :
    η ≫ (specCommMonAlgPullbackObjXIso M f Sf H).hom = η
proof:
:= by
  subst H
  let := f.hom.toAlgebra
  ext
  apply ((CommRingCat.isPushout_of_isPushout R S R[M] S[M]).op.map Scheme.Spec).hom_ext <;>
  · simp [Functor.Monoidal.ε_of_cartesianMonoidalCategory, RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra,
      CommRingCat.mkUnder, CommRingCat.of_carrier, -AlgHom.toUnder_right']
    simp [← Spec.map_id, ← Spec.map_comp]
    congr 1
    ext <;> simp

name: specCommMonAlgPullbackObjIso_mul_aux
statement:
@[reassoc]
private
lemma specCommMonAlgPullbackObjIso_mul_aux :
    (CartesianMonoidalCategory.prodComparisonIso (Over.pullback Sf) _ _).inv.left ≫
      pullback.fst _ _ ≫ (pullbackSpecIso R R[M] R[M]).hom =
    ((specCommMonAlgPullbackObjXIso M f Sf H).hom ⊗ₘ
      (specCommMonAlgPullbackObjXIso M f Sf H).hom).left ≫
      (pullbackSpecIso S _ _).hom ≫
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Algebra.TensorProduct.mapRingHom f.hom _ _
          (mapRingHom_comp_algebraMap f.hom (M := M))
          (mapRingHom_comp_algebraMap f.hom (M := M))))
proof:
:= by
  subst H
  let := f.hom.toAlgebra
  have H := (CommRingCat.isPushout_of_isPushout R S R[M] S[M]).op.map Scheme.Spec
  let e : (((commMonAlg R).op ⋙ bialgSpec R ⋙ (Over.pullback (Spec.map f)).mapMon).obj (.op M)).X ≅
    (((commMonAlg S).op ⋙ bialgSpec S).obj (.op M)).X :=
      Over.isoMk H.isoPullback.symm (by dsimp; simp; rfl)
  have hc := mapRingHom_comp_algebraMap f.hom (M := M)
  have h₂ := Algebra.TensorProduct.mapRingHom_comp_includeLeftRingHom _ _ _ hc hc
  have h₃ := Algebra.TensorProduct.mapRingHom_comp_includeRight _ _ _ hc hc
  apply_fun (Spec.map <| CommRingCat.ofHom ·) at h₂ h₃
  simp only [CommRingCat.ofHom_comp, Spec.map_comp] at h₂ h₃
  rw [← Category.assoc, ← Iso.eq_comp_inv]
  dsimp
  ext
  · simp [h₂]
    erw [Over.tensorHom_left_fst_assoc]
    simp [specCommMonAlgPullbackObjXIso, RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra]
    exact Over.prodComparisonIso_pullback_inv_left_fst_fst (Spec.map f) _ _
  · simp [h₃]
    erw [Over.tensorHom_left_snd_assoc]
    simp [specCommMonAlgPullbackObjXIso, RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra]
    exact Over.prodComparisonIso_pullback_inv_left_fst_snd' (Spec.map f) _ _

name: specCommMonAlgPullbackObjXIso_mul
statement:
lemma specCommMonAlgPullbackObjXIso_mul :
    μ ≫ (specCommMonAlgPullbackObjXIso M f Sf H).hom =
    ((specCommMonAlgPullbackObjXIso M f Sf H).hom ⊗ₘ
      (specCommMonAlgPullbackObjXIso M f Sf H).hom) ≫ μ
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [AlgHom.toUnder]
  
  subst H
  let := f.hom.toAlgebra
  have h₃ := comulAlgHom_comp_mapRingHom f.hom (M := M)
  have h₄ := (Bialgebra.comulAlgHom S S[M]).comp_algebraMap
  apply_fun (Spec.map <| CommRingCat.ofHom ·) at h₃ h₄
  simp only [AlgHom.toRingHom_eq_coe, CommRingCat.ofHom_comp, Spec.map_comp] at h₃ h₄
  ext
  apply ((CommRingCat.isPushout_of_isPushout R S R[M] S[M]).op.map Scheme.Spec).hom_ext
  · simpa [Functor.Monoidal.μ_of_cartesianMonoidalCategory, RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra,
      AlgHom.toUnder, h₃, specCommMonAlgPullbackObjXIso] using
        specCommMonAlgPullbackObjIso_mul_aux_assoc M f _ rfl
          (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Bialgebra.comulAlgHom R R[M]).toRingHom))
  · simp [Functor.Monoidal.μ_of_cartesianMonoidalCategory, RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra,
      AlgHom.toUnder, h₄, Algebra.TensorProduct.algebraMap_def, pullback.condition]
    erw [Over.tensorHom_left_snd_assoc]
    simp [specCommMonAlgPullbackObjXIso, RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra]
    exact Over.prodComparisonIso_pullback_inv_left_snd' (Spec.map f) ..

name: specCommMonAlgPullback_inv_app_hom_left_fst
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
lemma specCommMonAlgPullback_inv_app_hom_left_fst (M) :
    ((specCommMonAlgPullback f Sf H).inv.app M).hom.left ≫
      pullback.fst (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R R[↥(unop M)]))) _ =
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (mapRingHom M.unop f.hom))
proof:
:=
  let := f.hom.toAlgebra
  have H' := (CommRingCat.isPushout_of_isPushout R S R[M.unop] S[M.unop]).op.map Scheme.Spec
  H ▸ H'.isoPullback_hom_fst

name: specCommMonAlgPullback_inv_app_hom_left_snd
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
lemma specCommMonAlgPullback_inv_app_hom_left_snd (M) :
    ((specCommMonAlgPullback f Sf H).inv.app M).hom.left ≫
      pullback.snd (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R R[↥(unop M)]))) _ =
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap _ _))
proof:
:=
  let := f.hom.toAlgebra
  have H' := (CommRingCat.isPushout_of_isPushout R S R[M.unop] S[M.unop]).op.map Scheme.Spec
  H ▸ H'.isoPullback_hom_snd

name: charCongr_symm
statement:
@[simp]
lemma charCongr_symm (e : G ≅ H) [e.hom.IsOver S] [IsMonHom <| e.hom.asOver S] :
  (charCongr S e).symm = charCongr S e.symm

name: cocharCongr_symm
statement:
@[simp]
lemma cocharCongr_symm (e : G ≅ H) [IsCommMonObj <| G.asOver S] [IsCommMonObj <| H.asOver S]
    [e.hom.IsOver S] [IsMonHom <| e.hom.asOver S] :
  (cocharCongr S e).symm = cocharCongr S e.symm

name: cocharCongr_comp_charCongr
statement:
@[simp]
lemma cocharCongr_comp_charCongr [IsCommMonObj <| G.asOver S] [IsCommMonObj <| H.asOver S]
    (e : G ≅ H) [e.hom.IsOver S] [IsMonHom <| e.hom.asOver S] (a b) :
    (cocharCongr S e a).comp (charCongr S e b) = a.comp b

name: charDiag_symm_apply
statement:
lemma charDiag_symm_apply (g : G) :
    (charDiag R G).symm g = diagHomGrp _ (FreeAbelianGroup.lift fun _ ↦ g)

name: charDiag_diagHomGrp
statement: lemma charDiag_diagHomGrp (f : _ →+ G) : charDiag R G (diagHomGrp _ f) = f (.of 0)
proof:
:= by
  apply (charDiag R G).symm.injective
  simp only [AddEquiv.symm_apply_apply, PUnit.zero_eq, charDiag_symm_apply]
  congr 1
  ext
  simp only [FreeAbelianGroup.lift_apply_of]

name: cocharDiag_symm_apply
statement:
lemma cocharDiag_symm_apply (g : G →+ ℤ) :
    (cocharDiag R G).symm g =
      diagHomGrp _ ((FreeAbelianGroup.uniqueEquiv _).symm.toAddMonoidHom.comp g)

name: mem_span_setOf_iff_exists_linearCombination
statement:
lemma mem_span_setOf_iff_exists_linearCombination {p : M → Prop} {x : M} :
    x ∈ span R {a | p a} ↔ ∃ l : {a // p a} →₀ R, linearCombination R (↑) l = x

name: inv_convMul_cancel
statement:
private lemma inv_convMul_cancel (f : WithConv <| C →ₐc[R] A) :
    (toConv (.comp (antipodeAlgHom R A) f.ofConv) * toConv f.ofConv.toAlgHom) = 1
proof:
:= calc
  _ = toConv (.comp (HopfAlgebra.antipodeAlgHom R A) f.ofConv : C →ₐ[R] A) *
        toConv (.comp (.id R A) f.ofConv) := by simp
  _ = toConv (.comp (lmul' R) (.comp (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (HopfAlgebra.antipodeAlgHom R A)
       (.id R A)) <| .comp (Algebra.TensorProduct.map f.ofConv f.ofConv) (comulAlgHom R C))) := by
    rw [convMul_def, Algebra.TensorProduct.map_comp]
    simp only [comp_assoc]
  _ = toConv ((toConv (antipodeAlgHom R A) * toConv (AlgHom.id R A)).ofConv.comp f.ofConv) := by
    simp only [convMul_def, BialgHom.map_comp_comulAlgHom]
    simp only [comp_assoc]
  _ = _ := by simp [antipode_id_cancel, convOne_def, comp_assoc]

name: inv_def
statement: lemma inv_def (f : WithConv <| C →ₐc[R] A) : f⁻¹ = toConv (f.ofConv.comp antipodeBialgHom)

name: inv_apply
statement: @[simp] lemma inv_apply (f : WithConv <| C →ₐc[R] A) (c : C) : f⁻¹ c = f (antipode R c)
